lighter_prose.passage: The Aboriginal Australian concept of the songline is the deep metaphor here. A songline is a route across land that is also a song — the act of singing (walking, naming) the path activates the knowledge encoded there. summary: I read the fourteen member pages and, for each of the 32 links, the passage on the target (or the sentence where the target names the source). Of the 32: 18 label, 5 retype (mirrors for the Archive/SDKM and Graffiti/Semantic Delay pairs, deepens for Pages as Agents/JEWEL and Four Pillars of Enchanted Agency/Swarm Weave, member-of for Baton/Palace Ceremonies), 9 cut, 0 keep-as-is (none already carried a label). The cuts are the links where the target only appears in the source frontmatter or as an example string (Striatum as a sample agent ID) or where the real reason sits on a neighbouring page. Pattern: ceremony cards link their siblings and Substrate Skill by habit; the real relations are almost all named in a body paragraph on one side, usually the opposite side from the frontmatter that holds the link. Three pairs are held in both directions (Weave/Walk, Palace Map/BBS Blackboard, Weave/Spore Check): I judged the listed direction and noted the reverse duplicate in each rationale. Not settled: whether Palace Graffiti to SCHEMA deserves even a low-confidence label since SCHEMA never names graffiti; whether Baton to Palace Ceremonies as member-of should extend to all the other ceremony cards (outside my room); and the Enchanted Worker/Archive label is thin, resting on a Weave-flag comment rather than a body sentence. One newcomer inbound proposed: Project Stewardship System to VST Template.
